title: Descriptive Sentence Ladder - Blind Boxes
hp: Copy it in your book or type it on screen, then expand and improve one descriptive sentence at a time.
h2: Build a descriptive sentence about blind boxes from Level 1 to Level 3
intro: Tap a level to reveal it, then copy the sentence into your book or into the box. Students can compare how each version becomes more descriptive.

levels.label: Level 1: Base sentence
levels.say: Level 1. Copy the base sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: A blind box is a game of chance.
levels.ans: A blind box is a game of chance.

levels.label: Level 2: Add details
levels.say: Level 2. Copy the sentence, then add details about what is inside.
levels.text: A blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a hidden toy.
levels.ans: A blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a hidden toy.

levels.label: Level 3: Add descriptive adjectives
levels.say: Level 3. Copy the sentence, then add descriptive adjectives.
levels.text: A sealed blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a rare, hidden toy.
levels.ans: A sealed blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a rare, hidden toy.

levels.label: Full Sentence: Fully descriptive sentence
levels.say: Copy the fully descriptive sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: A sealed blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a rare, hidden toy that makes the outcome a complete surprise.
levels.ans: A sealed blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a rare, hidden toy that makes the outcome a complete surprise.

bh: Challenge: Put the descriptive sentence back together
bsay: Challenge. Put the words in order to make the descriptive sentence.
bsmall: Tap the chips in order to build the fully expanded sentence.
ans: A sealed blind box is a thrilling game of chance with a rare, hidden toy that makes the outcome a complete surprise.
